more_info.overview: Vermiculite is a natural hydrated silicate containing magnesium, aluminium and iron. It is supplied in mineral preparations that can include heat-expanded material. The EFSA record concerns its proposed use as a binder and anti-caking material in animal feed. That application concerns feed consistency and handling. It does not establish a typical human-food use for this historical dataset entry.
more_info.precautions: EFSA could not reach a conclusion on safety for the target animals or for users handling the evaluated vermiculite feed preparation in 2020. This assessment concerns a feed product and handling exposure, rather than reported effects from eating a food containing the material.
more_info.banned_in:
EFSA identified safety concerns or unresolved safety data for the animal-feed preparation in 2020.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
